action_items: Non-blocking (test-tooling ergonomics only, NOT a product bug): conftest.py auto-injects X-Step-Up-Bypass on all requests; my initial live HTTP negative-test needed to explicitly set session/request X-Step-Up-Bypass:"" to exercise the REAL step-up gate. Documented in the test file. During test authoring this caused two real rollbacks that I roll-forwarded symmetrically (pointer swap) — final active version restored to hash=3a96d4b6e86d1c43 (created 2026-07-25T15:27:11.038000), mode=supervised_live. No mode raise. Consider adding a pytest marker or fixture that trivially opts out of the auto-bypass for negative-path tests to prevent accidental live mutations.
Cosmetic: WebSocket /api/ws upgrade returns 403 during Playwright sessions (cookie forwarding on wss upgrade). Pre-existing across iterations; ignored per iter-92 note.
Cosmetic: New test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter93_live_http.py added — regenerate /app/docs/TEST_MANIFEST.md (now +1 file / +6 tests).
critical_code_review_comments: record_swallow instrumentation is non-behavioral (except-handler additions only) — bridge/execution 119/119 regression confirms no behavior drift.

config_promotion.rollback is symmetric via pointer swap AND writes a roll_forward_version_id — safe for accidental double-invocation; live-config-preserving on double-rollback (verified twice this run).

mode_guard_applied returns false when rollback would not raise mode — consistent with 'rollback can never raise operational_mode'. Verified: after two rollbacks operational_mode stayed supervised_live.

ConfigVersionsCard.jsx does not proactively open the step-up dialog before invoking rollback — it relies on the axios interceptor's 403 handling. Works, but a preflight step-up prompt would avoid a wasted server round-trip and give a snappier UX.

For admins without 2FA, the server returns 403 mfa_enrollment_required rather than opening the step-up modal — the UI surfaces this as a toast (screenshot). Fine as an admin-hardening reminder but the review request wording implied the step-up modal itself would open; document expected behavior for admin (2FA-off) accounts.

context_for_next_testing_agent: conftest.py auto-adds X-Step-Up-Bypass to every requests.Session call. To hit the REAL step-up gate from a live-HTTP test, set session.headers['X-Step-Up-Bypass']='' or add an empty override header per request. Config rollback is a pointer swap: calling it twice restores the original active pointer — useful for symmetric-safety on admin. /api/config/rollback ignores JSON body target_version (endpoint sig is account_id query-only). Live broker is connected — do NOT start/stop bots and never leave a rollback in effect on admin. Batch A (Tier 4 Governance) + Batch B+C (Tier 5/11/12/14) all still green from prior iterations. Frontend: step-up modal for admin without 2FA surfaces as a toast (mfa_enrollment_required); modal testid still triggered.
